g.text: do / the Owner writes the requirement
do / cumin waits for a free slot
do / the Planner splits the requirement
do / the Owner reviews the plan and the sub-issues
do / the agents work on the sub-issues
do / the Planner checks the merged work
do / the Owner decides the acceptance
mark the requirement as in work
the Owner adds ready to a sub-issue
[the Owner added ready, the blockers are closed,
/ cumin requests the split from the Planner
ask the Owner to review the plan
[no Planner runs, cumin verified the split,
[no Planner runs, cumin verified the split,
[no Planner runs, cumin could not verify
stop the split for the Owner
[no Planner runs, and: the Planner asked
a question, or cumin could not verify the split
mark the requirement as in work
the Owner adds ready to a sub-issue
ask the Owner about the remaining sub-issues
[only sub-issues without a status label remain]
[every sub-issue is closed, cumin wrote the
follow-up notes, cumin has a free slot]
[no Planner runs, the Planner wrote no
/ cumin requests the acceptance check again
stop the acceptance check for the Owner
[no Planner runs, and: the Planner asked
a question, or no acceptance check the second time]
mark the requirement as in work
the Owner adds ready to a sub-issue
A box is a state: a label on GitHub, without "cumin/status/". "do /" says who works in the state.
An arrow is a transition: [guard] / effect, each with its actor. The first line is the name of the transition in issue-states.md.
Every guard reads only facts on GitHub and "no agent runs for this issue".
